name: Algeria delivery stop-desks
description: Geocoded stop-desks from the openly-published Yalidine/Guepex federated relay plus Anderson, Noest, Maystro, ZR Express and Swift Express's own agency lists: 581 points across 11 carriers. Most Algerian COD carriers (90+) don't publish an open agency list; see carriers.json for the full registry and coverage.json for per-carrier presence.
